column1: # Genome assemblies available to the pipeline.
# Select one per run:   PAX6_ASSEMBLY=GRCm39 sbatch align_batch.sh <study> <batch>
# Default is the first uncommented row.
# ASSEMBLY IS A PROPERTY OF A COUNT MATRIX, NOT OF A BATCH.
#   BAMs are written to <mapping_root>/<assembly>/, so the same libraries can
#   exist against several assemblies at once without colliding. Counting reads
#   from one assembly's directory and records which, so a matrix can never
#   contain a mixture.
# ANNOTATION MUST MATCH THE ASSEMBLY.
#   GENCODE vM25 is the last release built on GRCm38. Anything later is on
#   GRCm39. Pairing an annotation with the wrong assembly produces coordinates
#   that silently do not correspond to genes.
# INDEX TYPE IS A CONFOUND WHEN COMPARING ASSEMBLIES.
#   The GRCm38 index is transcript-aware (splice sites and exons built in) but
#   carries NO SNPs, despite its directory name `genome_snp_tran`. Checked
#   2026-09-25 with hisat2-inspect: 0 SNPs, 274,187 splice sites. The VCF
#   offered at build time used Ensembl chromosome names (1, 2, ...) and the
#   FASTA GENCODE names (chr1, chr2, ...), so the SNP extractor matched nothing
#   and skipped every variant without an error. A plain GRCm39 index differs
#   from it only in having no splice sites built in, which
#   --known-splicesite-infile supplies at alignment time. Record index_type
#   either way.
# assembly
GRCm38
GRCm39
